title: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India, (2015) 5 SCC 1
content.facts: The Court reviewed restrictions on online speech under the Information Technology Act.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether IT Act s. 66A impermissibly restricted constitutional speech.
content.ratioDecidendi: Section 66A was vague and overbroad and violated Article 19(1)(a); it was not saved by Article 19(2).
content.holding: Section 66A was struck down in its entirety.
content.relevance: Use only as historical status; do not present s. 66A as a current offence.
